0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The muscular alchemist needs help finding ingredients for paint.

25.original: Coat the muscular alchemist in fragrant oil.

26.original: Lie in wait at the designated location and defeat the vajralangula.

27.original: Deliver the amra to the muscular alchemist.

48.original: You there! Adventurer! I find myself in need of assistance. You will help me, won't you?

49.original: You see, I received an order for custom paints, but the necessary ingredients are rather rare. The amra in particular is difficult to come by, as it must be taken from a vajralangula.

50.original: And not just any old fruit will do! Only one held by the strongest, most virile male specimen will suffice.

51.original: I know of a sure way to attract a suitable vajralangula, but I'm afraid defeating the beast is beyond me. If only a strong, brave, kind adventurer could protect poor little me!

55.original: I feel safer already! Come now, I will lead you to where the vajralangula gather. We head southeast.

56.original: I've kept you waiting long enough. Let's get to it, shall we?

57.original: Take this perfume and douse my frail, meager body in it. I must be as a flower dripping with sweet nectar!

58.original: Quickly, now! Slather it on, else I won't catch the attention of even the weakest vajralangula.

60.original: Now, I'll use my wiles and enticing scent to lure a vajralangula this way. You wait here, and prepare to strike him down!

61.original: I'll lure a vajralangula this way. You wait here, and prepare to strike!

62.original: Such valiance! I could hardly tear my eyes away as you heroically slayed the beast! ...Now, the fruit, if you please.

63.original: Mmm, yes. Perfectly, succulently ripe. This will make a fine paint.

64.original: Our work here is done. Let us return to the Great Work before another vajralangula sets its sights on me.

65.original: Many thanks for your assistance, adventurer. I never imagined I could procure such a fine component for my paint.

66.original: Say, do you know why the vajralangula carry this fruit? They present them to their desired mates. Hence the scented oils. Pheromones, you see.

67.original: The amra is also the official fruit of Thavnair. You can eat it or use it as painting material as I shall, of course, but it is also said to ward off evil, and secure a strong family lineage.

68.original: But there's more to this fruit than mere superstition. It has sufficient antibacterial properties to be used as a household remedy to keep any family well.

69.original: Oh but listen to me, rambling on and on! Allow me to thank you once more. I hope our paths will cross again!
